brief_summary: In this randomized, cross-over study 20 subjects who are undergoing testosterone (T) therapy for the treatment of T deficiency will receive both subcutaneous testosterone therapy and intramuscular testosterone therapy. One group will receive a SQ injection followed by an IM injection and one group will receive an IM injection followed by a SQ injection. eligibility_table.criterion: Ability to read, write, and understand English
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 19 years old and likely has the ability to read, write, and understand English.

eligibility_table.criterion: Age greater than or equal to 18

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a serum testosterone level of 65 ng/dL, indicating testosterone deficiency.

eligibility_table.criterion: Pre-enrollment testosterone concentration of less than 350 ng/dL
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's pre-enrollment testosterone concentration less than 350 ng/dL?

eligibility_table.criterion: Planning to initiate testosterone treatment at MHB
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is seeking treatment for testosterone deficiency, suggesting a plan to initiate testosterone treatment.

eligibility_table.criterion: Willing to be followed at MHB for at least one month
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is likely willing to be followed at MHB for at least one month as part of treatment.

eligibility_table.criterion: Willing to provide informed consent for this study
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 19 years old and should be capable of providing informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Previous exposure to exogenous T, clomiphene citrate, or other Selective Estrogen Receptor Modulators, unless off therapy for at least 12 weeks
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had any previous exposure to exogenous testosterone or related medications.

eligibility_table.criterion: American Urological Association Prostate Symptom score of 15 or greater or significant prostatic symptoms
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have an American Urological Association Prostate Symptom score of 15 or greater?

eligibility_table.criterion: History of carcinoma, tumors or induration of the prostate or the male mammary gland, including suspicion thereof
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of a history of carcinoma, tumors, or induration of the prostate or male mammary gland.

eligibility_table.criterion: Pre-enrollment serum PSA more than 4 ng/ml
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's pre-enrollment serum PSA level greater than 4 ng/ml?

eligibility_table.criterion: Serious psychiatric disease or uncontrolled medical illness, as suspected from the history or clinical examination
eligibility_table.justification: There is no evidence of serious psychiatric disease or uncontrolled medical illness in the patient's history.

eligibility_table.criterion: Used any sex hormones or steroidal anabolic drug supplements within 28 days before pre-enrollment testosterone collection or at any time throughout the study
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not used any sex hormones or steroidal anabolic drugs within the specified timeframe.

eligibility_table.criterion: Incapable of giving informed consent or complying with the protocol
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is capable of giving informed consent and complying with the protocol.
